rules: Bound regular-file reads before allocation, including generated-workspace manifests. Reject malformed UTF-8 instead of replacement decoding.
Track raw source bytes, manifest bytes, distinct visited modules, parsed import edges and maximum traversal depth. The entry depth is zero; repeated already visited modules are not charged twice.
Keep source-root, generated-membership, closure-hash, homogeneous-language, cycle and missing-import checks mandatory.
Reject unknown, negative or non-safe-integer limits. Exhaustion throws kind resourceExhausted with the configured dimension before compiler loading or output publication.
Bind configured source limits into preparation ActionId and observed counts into PassExecution. Check-only receipts also expose the observation.
Compatible larger limits preserve the source snapshot identity; no global resource monotonicity theorem is claimed.
evidence: Focused generated/standalone source fixtures, small-to-larger limits, early exhaustion and actual checked-build action binding; extensive adversarial/formal assurance remains pending.
